record.question: Who recently bagged two Grammy Awards for best musical score?
record.explanation: Answer A: A.R.Rahman. The Recording Academy records two 2010 wins for Rahman: compilation soundtrack Slumdog Millionaire and song Jai Ho. The stem's phrase two awards for best musical score is imprecise: neither is the separate Best Score Soundtrack category, won by Michael Giacchino. Rahman remains uniquely identifiable among the choices; show the category precision note. Reference: https://www.grammy.com/artists/ar-rahman/6529/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
